text: In summary, five isoindigo quaternary ammonium salt derivatives were synthesized in this paper using isoindigo as the parent body to explore their application as levelers in PCB through-hole plating. The results of electrochemical experiments show that five IID-QAS exhibit diferent degrees of copper deposition inhibition, among which IID-C4-QL has the best inhibition performance and strong convective adsorption ability. Theoretical calculations and molecular simulations show that IID-C4-QL has the strongest adsorption capacity among the five compounds.
